item.title: Saudi Eyes 10 Million Barrels a Day of Oil Pipe Capacity
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.description: Saudi Arabia is looking at ways to expand its oil pipeline capacity to destinations outside the Persian Gulf to 10 million barrels a day within two to three years, said Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman.

item.title: Container Surge Continues at Port of Los Angeles
item.dc:creator: Lori Ann LaRocco
item.description: The Port of Los Angeles reported its best single month in its history. In a media briefing, port executive director Gene Seroka announced the port processed 1,042,652 TEUs, 23k TEUs more than the July 2025 record.
